summary: Turns your 2D entities into the images lighting needs: what glows, what blocks light and how things move. Every entity with a `Transform2D`, a shape (`Circle2D`, `Rectangle2D` or `Triangle2D`) and a `Material` is drawn automatically. Add it to any lit 2D scene.
summaryText: Turns your 2D entities into the images lighting needs: what glows, what blocks light and how things move. Every entity with a Transform2D, a shape (Circle2D, Rectangle2D or Triangle2D) and a Material is drawn automatically. Add it to any lit 2D scene.
